name: Can I replace my tub with a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my tub with a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting a bathtub into a walk-in shower is a popular remodeling option. This process involves removing the old tub and modifying the space to install a shower pan, new wall surrounds, fixtures, and potentially a glass enclosure. It can improve accessibility, enhance the bathroom's modern aesthetic, and often makes the space feel larger. This type of conversion usually takes longer than a direct tub replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can replace a tub with a walk-in shower, which involves removing the tub and installing a shower pan and fixtures.
